title: Mail System
description: A Simple Plugin That Allows Players To Send Private Messages And Offline Mail.
body:
# MailSystem Plugin v1.0.0

A Simple plugin that allows players to send private messages and offline mail. The system keeps the community connected by delivering messages whether players are online or offline.

## Features

- Send private messages to online players with `/mail <player> <message>`
- Send messages to offline players that are delivered when they join
- Check pending messages with `/inbox`
- Direct messaging with `/say <player> <message>` (like /msg)
- Clean inbox with `/inbox clean`
- Fully configurable message formats with color codes
- Enable/disable the entire mail system via config
- Reload configuration without restarting the server with `/mailsys reload`
- Compatible with all major Minecraft server implementations (Paper, Bukkit, Spigot, Purpur)
- Supports Minecraft 1.13+

## Commands

### Player Commands

- `/mail <player> <message>` - Send a message to any player (online or offline)
- `/say <player> <message>` - Send a direct message to an online player
- `/inbox` - Check all pending messages
- `/inbox clean` - Clear all messages from your inbox

### Admin Commands

- `/mailsys reload` - Reload the plugin configuration

## Installation

1. Download the MailSystem-1.0.0.jar file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. The plugin will generate a config file in `plugins/MailSystem/`
